summary: Tested the 3 approved changes. All the flows asked for work end to end. Backend: 5 of 5 pytest tests pass. They cover cancel returning 403 for optica and usuario and 404 for superadmin with an unknown id, a V2 sale (qty 2) that lowers frame stock and gets it back exactly on cancel, a second cancel returning 400 without restoring stock twice, and optica creating and editing an IGSS patient with NOG discounts. UI checks: (F3) superadmin sees the Ventas menu item, the date/status/search filters, row and detail buttons for detail, reprint and cancel, the reprint popup opens with the ticket, and cancelling from the UI works (confirm dialog -> toast -> status Cancelado, stock restored 8->9). Optica sees detail and reprint with 0 cancel buttons. (F2) Optica created an IGSS patient in Pacientes using the catalog NOG selector (acreditados 0->1), then edited it adding a 2nd order through the free-text 'Otro' input (acreditados ->2). (F1) In Agenda, Marcar llegada on an incomplete patient opens the Completar modal. The cf-igss-ordenes section appears for IGSS, Agregar orden stays disabled until a unit is chosen, and NOG, SPS, Código and Procedimiento can be filled. Saving updated the patient's igss_ordenes, set the appointment to Presente and discounted the NOG (0->1). All test data was cleaned up and NOG 28017447 is back to acreditados=0.

minor.issue: The response model drops items_v2, so the Ventas detail 'Productos' section and the reprinted ticket show NO product lines for POS (V2) sales, which are most sales. Seen on ORD-202611-0003: the ticket table is empty. This hurts the new 'reimprimir ticket' feature. Fix: add items_v2 (and discount fields) to OpticaSaleResponse.

When patient_id is empty (Consumidor Final / walk-in name), patient_name is overwritten with 'Paciente no encontrado'. As a result the list, detail and ticket show 'Paciente no encontrado', and searching by client name for walk-in sales returns 0 (searching 'TEST_UICancel' found nothing, while searching by order number worked). doctor_name is also wiped when doctor_id is empty even though V2 stores doctor_name. Fix: only override when the patient is found; otherwise keep the stored patient_name/doctor_name.

The date filter compares raw UTC created_at strings with local dates. Sales made after 18:00 Guatemala time fall on the next UTC day, so they are excluded from 'Hasta' on their real day and included on the following day. Convert the GT day range to a UTC range, as caja/dashboard already do.

Does not exclude cancelled sales or their payments. After a cancel, the POS daily summary (OpticaPOS) still counts the sale's total and cash. The cierre in caja.py does exclude them, so the two disagree.

The sale's payment records stay in place with no refund/egreso entry. Totals are only excluded wherever a report filters status!=cancelado (see resumen-dia above). Confirm whether a cash refund movement is expected when a paid sale is cancelled.

ui_bugs.issue: After a cancel only fetchSales() runs, not fetchDashboard(), so the KPI cards stay stale. 'Ventas del Mes' showed Q245 / 4 órdenes while the API returned Q195 / 3.
Products list empty and client shown as 'Paciente no encontrado' (both caused by the backend issues above)

issues: Desde/Hasta use the browser's native date picker (input type=date) instead of the shadcn Calendar used elsewhere
Search input and status Select have no data-testid
Payment history row shows an empty '()' when the method/creator is blank

action_items: Add items_v2 to OpticaSaleResponse so the Ventas detail and reprinted ticket list the products
Fix enrich_sale so it does not overwrite patient_name/doctor_name when there is no linked patient/doctor (this also fixes search by client name)
Make the dateFrom/dateTo filter in GET /optica/sales use a Guatemala-day to UTC range
Exclude cancelled sales and their payments in _resumen_ventas (POS resumen-dia and consolidado)
Call fetchDashboard() after a successful cancel in OpticaVentas
Optional: add data-testid to the Ventas search input and status select; use the shadcn date picker
critical_code_review_comments: OpticaVentas.js handlePrintTicket inserts patient_name, doctor_name and item names into document.write HTML without escaping (possible XSS/HTML injection from patient names)
GET /optica/sales loads up to 1000 sales and enriches each one (several DB lookups per sale, N+1) before filtering by search in Python. It is slow and silently caps results at 1000.
Layout.js always adds 'Ventas' for any user with canViewOptica, without an isMenuEnabled check, unlike the other optica menu items

OpticaVentas.js (1456 lines) and Agenda.js (3009 lines) are far over the 700-line guideline. The órdenes IGSS block is duplicated between Pacientes.js and Agenda.js and could be one OrdenesIgssEditor component.
The NOG selector testid in Agenda is patient-igss-nog-select-cf-{idx} (idSuffix '-cf-idx'), not cf-orden-nog-{idx}

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested flows work; 2 display bugs caused by the backend response model
